_doc: Read by tools/artifact-build.mjs. entries: one artifact each (scope 'site' publishes every page below plus assets; 'single' publishes its entry plus assets and links into its 'site' artifact by --url). pages: SPEC section 8, in order; 'dir/*.html' globs are allowed; a page that does not exist yet is skipped with a warning. selftest: the count gate (count = regex counted in the self-test page, claim = regex whose group 1 is a quoted count, claimedIn = files that quote it). vars.ignore: names the vars gate treats as declared.
